convert.title: Convert
convert.subtitle: Build a device file from an image, via a DeviceLink toward the loaded paper. Separate from printing — the output is saved to disk.
convert.no_source_profile: This image carries no embedded ICC profile — it cannot be converted (no source space to read). Re-export it with an embedded profile.
convert.gamut_help: The collink gamut-mapping intent used to fit the image into the paper's gamut. These are collink's own gamut intents (not a profile's ICC rendering intent). Each shows its command and its cost — none is “best”. Relative is the current default; the last entry is a freeglaz custom (it does not use -G).
convert.gamut_desc_relative: Current behaviour. Slightly lightens saturated colours; separates the deepest shadows the least.
convert.gamut_desc_luminance_matched: Matches the white→black luminance axis: preserves separation in the deepest shadows. Lightens saturated colours.
convert.gamut_desc_perceptual: 3-D perceptual compression. Lightens saturated colours and desaturates them.
convert.gamut_desc_luminance_preserving: 3-D perceptual compression that favours lightness. Preserves deep-shadow separation; lightens saturated colours.
convert.gamut_desc_luminance_priority: Custom abstract: chroma compression at constant luminance. Preserves the lightness of saturated colours; desaturates them in exchange. Separates the deepest shadows less.
convert.gamut_desc_relative_bpc: Relative colorimetric with black point compensation: lifts the whole dark range to avoid clipping below the paper's printable black. In exchange it lightens — “washes” — the blacks. Useful mainly if the file holds detail below the printable black; no benefit if its blacks already sit above it.
convert.tau_help: Trade-off cursor for “Saturated-colour lightness”. Lower τ protects luminance more and sacrifices more chroma; higher τ keeps more chroma at the cost of some luminance recoupling. τ = 1 is the reference, not an optimum.
convert.quality_help: Resolution of the DeviceLink's 3-D conversion grid (collink -q). Higher = finer grid → smoother gradients and fewer interpolation artefacts, but a slower build and a larger link. It does NOT change the number of inks or the profile — only how finely the source→paper mapping is sampled. High is a good default for photos; Ultra only for critical work.
convert.ge_help: Which resident characterization of the loaded paper is used as the destination: GE ON (gloss enhancer applied) or GE OFF. The two do not have the same colour — pick the one matching how you will actually print.
convert.image_aware_help: Independent of the intent. Off: map the full source-profile gamut (default). On: map only the gamut the image actually occupies (extracted with tiffgamut) — compresses just what really falls out of the paper's gamut and leaves already-printable colours alone. Useful when the perceptual intent otherwise shifts the whole image.
convert.viewcond_desc_default: collink defaults: average surround, adaptation 50 cd/m², background 20%, adapted white = media white. Not specific to print viewing.
convert.viewcond_desc_pm: Print evaluation with partial Mid-tone adaptation. mtaf 0.7, Wxyz2 D50. Intended for papers containing FWA/OBE brighteners viewed in an environment with a noticeably warmer white point than the paper: the white point stays that of the paper, but mid-tones are partially adapted to the warmer white point, possibly reducing visual discrepancy. Note (Gill): this situation doesn't often arise in real-world viewing of such media; and it is a trap to evaluate FWA/OBE-rich paper under standard proofing conditions, whose spectrally flat grey surround unnaturally emphasizes the white-point difference.
convert.viewcond_note: A refinement, not a strong control: expect a subtle-to-marginal effect (a few levels at most), mostly on the perceptual intents with saturated content — near-zero with relative colorimetric, and it can be nil on some profiles.
convert.dest_no_paper: No paper loaded — load a paper in the Z9 to resolve the destination profile.
convert.run_and_print_help: Converts, then loads the device file into the Print tab (raw device passthrough — the values reach the inks untouched). You set the geometry and confirm there; nothing prints automatically.
convert.offline_hint: Z9 unreachable — the destination profile cannot be resolved while offline.
convert.error_unsupported_lut: Profile not supported by the Convert module. This profile uses ICC mAB/mBA tables, which the Argyll conversion engine currently used by freeglaz does not support. Convert accepts profiles using mft1/mft2 tables.

profils.validate_caveat: INDEPENDENT validation: the profile is tested on a chart ≠ its creation set (true predictive accuracy, not optimistic self-coherence). The result reflects the CURRENT physical state (paper/GE/calibration) — so it also detects DRIFT since the profile was built.
profils.validate_indep_ok: Independence verified: {{pct}} % overlap with the creation chart (low).
profils.validate_indep_bad: ⚠ High overlap with creation ({{pct}} %) — validation drifts toward self-coherence. Regenerate the chart (more distinct distribution).
profils.validate_indep_unknown: Profile without embedded creation measurements — overlap not verifiable (independence assumed from the -q distribution).
profils.check_caveat: Self-coherence: checks the profile against ITS OWN creation patches (best case, optimistic). Mainly catches measurement anomalies (misreads), NOT real predictive quality — that is measured by an independent validation (chart ≠ creation). A good score here ≠ excellent profile.
profils.check_iso_ref: Scale reference (context, not a target): ISO 12647-7/8 (CMYK offset proofing) places “good” around avg ΔE < 3 / max < 6. For fine-art RGB photo, the stricter house grid above prevails.
profils.check_no_measurements: This profile does not carry its creation measurements (no embedded ti3) — self-coherence cannot be computed. Use an independent validation (chart ≠ creation) to assess its accuracy.

view3d.entry_eff_perceptual_description: Volume of the Lab space effectively renderable by the device using the perceptual intent. Perceptual compresses out-of-gamut colors to preserve relationships between colors — useful for natural images. Computed by projecting the device's RGB cube surface via the A2B0 LUT.
view3d.entry_eff_relative_description: Volume of the Lab space effectively renderable under relative colorimetric intent. This intent clips out-of-gamut colors to the nearest boundary without touching in-gamut colors — useful for faithful reproduction and soft-proofing. Computed by projecting the device's RGB cube surface via the A2B1 LUT.
view3d.entry_eff_saturation_description: Volume of the Lab space effectively renderable under saturation intent. This intent favors perceived saturation over colorimetric accuracy — useful for graphics and presentations. Computed by projecting the device's RGB cube surface via the A2B2 LUT.
view3d.entry_A2B0_description: Conversion table from the device (RGB or CMYK) to the connection space (Lab or XYZ), under perceptual intent. Used by the system when an image tagged with this profile is read to produce absolute colorimetric coordinates.
view3d.entry_A2B1_description: Conversion table from the device to the connection space, under relative colorimetric intent. 1:1 conversion when possible, clipping of out-of-gamut colors to the nearest boundary.
view3d.entry_A2B2_description: Conversion table from the device to the connection space, under saturation intent. Preserves perceived saturation more than colorimetric accuracy.
view3d.entry_B2A0_description: Conversion table from the connection space to the device, under perceptual intent. Used when printing: compresses the source gamut into the device gamut while preserving relationships between colors.
view3d.entry_B2A1_description: Conversion table from the connection space to the device, under relative colorimetric intent. In-gamut colors preserved exactly, out-of-gamut colors clipped to the boundary.
view3d.entry_B2A2_description: Conversion table from the connection space to the device, under saturation intent. Maximizes rendered saturation, typical intent for graphics.
view3d.entry_gamt_description: Gamut indicator provided by the profiler: for each PCS coordinate, a value indicating whether it is renderable by the device (0) or out of gamut (value increasing with distance). The 3D visualization shows the transition boundary between the two. Represents the profiler's view, to be compared with the effective gamut computed on the device surface.
view3d.interactions_hint: Drag: rotate · Scroll: zoom · Right-click + drag (or Ctrl + drag on Mac): pan · Double-click: reset (twice quickly → fallback view)

slice2d.area_uncomputable_hint: Contour cannot be chained into a single closed loop (self-intersection at a fold, or pathological mesh at this L). Indicates a non-physical profile at this level, not a computation error.

mapping.empty_slice: No slice at L*={{L}} (out of gamut)
mapping.interactions_hint: Comparison of the same profile's intents on the same a*b* slice. At a given L, perceptual compresses out-of-gamut colors (tighter contour), relative clips them to the boundary (contour closer to the surface). At extreme L (shadows/highlights), perceptual and relative can diverge — this is faithful to the profile, not a computation error.

modify_mechanical.done_banner: New mechanical properties are in effect. CLC for this paper has been marked obsolete and must be redone.

logs.empty_hint: Expand the date range or remove a severity filter.

wizard_profile_paper.title: ICC Profiling
wizard_profile_paper.action_print_and_scan_desc: Full workflow in one session. One A3 sheet or about 18 cm of 24″ roll. Recommended.
wizard_profile_paper.action_print_only_desc: Prints the chart only. One A3 sheet or about 18 cm of 24″ roll. Spectrophotometric scan can be done later.
wizard_profile_paper.action_scan_only_desc: Scans an already-printed chart to generate the ICC profile. Chart must have been printed previously.
wizard_profile_paper.end_print_only_hint: Let the chart dry, then open the profiling wizard and choose "Scan only" on this same paper to finalize the ICC profile.
wizard_profile_paper.intro_description: HP profiling prints a 464-patch chart on your paper, dries, scans with the integrated spectrophotometer, then computes an ICC profile. Full workflow ~10 min.
wizard_profile_paper.intro_print_only: This step prints only the 464-patch chart on your paper. Scanning and ICC profile computation will be done in a later session, once the chart is dry. Duration ~2 min.
wizard_profile_paper.intro_scan_only: This step scans a 464-patch chart already printed and computes the ICC profile. Load the previously printed chart in the Z9 before starting. Duration ~3 min.
wizard_profile_paper.sheet_required_print_only: A manually fed sheet (A3 or A3+) is required. The Z9 will refuse to print on roll.
wizard_profile_paper.sheet_required_scan_only: A manually fed sheet (A3 or A3+) loaded with the printed chart is required.
wizard_profile_paper.param_name_invalid: Letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and underscores only (1-63 characters)
wizard_profile_paper.param_ge_hint: Improves bright uniformity on solid color areas (glossy/satin papers)
wizard_profile_paper.param_ge_unsupported_hint: This paper does not support the Gloss Enhancer
wizard_profile_paper.param_overwrite_warning: A custom profile already exists for this paper with GE {{ge_state}}. The new profiling will overwrite the existing one — a backup is created automatically for rollback from the detail panel.
wizard_profile_paper.validation_paper_not_loaded_message: Load this paper into the Z9 before continuing.
wizard_profile_paper.validation_busy_message: An operation is already running: {{operation}}. Wait for it to finish.
wizard_profile_paper.validation_no_clc_message: No CLC calibration found for this paper. We recommend running a CLC before profiling for better results.
wizard_profile_paper.validation_clc_pending_message: This paper's CLC calibration is pending (created but not yet run). We recommend running it before profiling for better results.
wizard_profile_paper.progress_can_close: Profiling cannot be interrupted once started. You can close this window, the operation will continue in the background.
wizard_profile_paper.end_success_colorsync_hint: To use this profile in your editing software, export it from the detail panel and place the .icc file in your user ColorSync folder (~/Library/ColorSync/Profiles/).
wizard_profile_paper.end_error_subtitle: An error occurred during the {{phase}} phase.
wizard_profile_paper.end_error_no_waste: The paper remains loaded, no additional consumables will be wasted. You can modify the configuration or retry.

scan.unsupported_model: Built-in measurement unavailable on this model: freeglaz drives the built-in spectrophotometer on the DesignJet Z9 only. On the Z9 Pro, this measurement crashes the printer.

roles.excluded_title: excluded: out of profile, but kept and shown

error.not_found: Scan not found: this measurement file no longer exists in the chart.
error.unreadable: Unreadable measurements: this scan's ti3 file is damaged or incomplete. The technical details are recorded in the freeglaz log (freeglaz.log).
error.unavailable: Measurements unavailable: technical error while reading. Try again.

qc.hint: Sort by ΔE spread: suspect patches rise to the top. ⚠ = outlier reading (farthest from the others). Rejecting a reading → the patch averages over its remaining readings. Reversible.
qc.last_valid: Last valid reading of this patch — cannot reject it (patch would have no measurement).
qc.legend: ⚠ outlier · struck = rejected · frozen columns: patch · ΔE spread · device RGB

delta.verdict_isolated: Isolated spike on patch {{patch}} = likely contamination (dust, insect, failed registration). Inspect before averaging.
delta.verdict_danger: High, spread-out divergence — check the chart before averaging.
delta.verdict_warn: Moderate, spread-out divergence (warm/saturated tones?) = likely drying between two scans — check the chart.

roll.scanning_hint_warn: Do not touch the chart or the panel.
roll.scanning_hint_post: The scan cannot be safely interrupted — please wait. You may close this window: the scan keeps running in the background and you will find it still in progress.
roll.reposition_detail: Sheet: reload it dry. Roll: rewind to the MAX at the panel (until the auto-stop, without disengaging) — the end-of-scan feed-back is not enough.
roll.cooldown_sol: SOL cooldown: wait before relaunching the scan (firmware protection).
roll.retry_registration: Registration failed. Rewind the chart to the MAXIMUM at the panel (hold the button until the auto-stop), wait for the cooldown, then relaunch. Your previous scans are preserved.
roll.already_running: A scan is already running (or another chart has an open scan).
roll.session_scans_one: {{count}} scan already taken on this chart — “Scan” adds one more (repeatability / average).
roll.session_scans_other: {{count}} scans already taken on this chart — “Scan” adds one more (repeatability / average).
roll.less_than_two_scans: Fewer than 2 stable scans: nothing to compare.

moved_modal.title: Check the chart to scan
moved_modal.roll: Roll: rewind the chart to the maximum at the panel (hold the button until it stops automatically, without disengaging it).
moved_modal.sheet: Sheet: reload the dry chart in the manual feed.

blocked_modal.title: A scan is already open on another chart
blocked_modal.body_suffix: has an open scan. Close it to scan this one.
blocked_modal.finish_and_scan: Close it and scan this one

base.average_recommended_mid: (recommended): averages the {{n}} KEPT scans → cuts measurement noise below the single-scan floor (~0.10 ΔE).
base.single_kept: 1 scan kept. To average, keep ≥2 scans (or run a 2nd scan).
base.drying_note: Drying: measurements drift while the ink dries (RC/gloss ~30 min, matte/canvas longer; saturated/dark slower). Scan again when ready.

confirm.chart_body: Permanently deletes the chart image, the measurements (ti3) and the metadata. An already-built ICC profile (separate file) is not affected. Irreversible.
confirm.lighten_body: Deletes the large TIFF chart image but KEEPS the measurements (re-profiling/re-validating stays possible). The chart will no longer be reprintable.
confirm.scan_body: Permanently deletes this scan (ti3 + cgats) — irreversible (unlike “exclude”, which keeps it). A profile built from this set will then note an earlier provenance (rebuild to update it).

mesures.title: Measurements
mesures.intro: Chart library — all papers, all stages. Viewing (scans, repeatability, profile) is always available.
mesures.sources_hint: Same paper and GE. Aggregates more measurements for a denser profile (the current chart is always included).
mesures.open_in_scan_flow_hint: Scanning a chart (hardware) happens in the scan flow, which requires the paper loaded. Building/rebuilding the profile happens here, in software.
mesures.profile_conflict_body: A profile “{{name}}” already exists in this paper's library. “Replace” puts the new profile in its place; the old file is kept, with its tags and notes, in the paper's backups (.replaced folder, not listed). Tags and notes are not carried over to the new profile. “Keep both” adds the new profile under another name and leaves the old one untouched.
mesures.build_done_installable: Ready to install on the printer.
mesures.build_done_not_ranged: Profile built, but not filed (unknown printer) — not installable.
mesures.profile_conflict_body_build: A profile “{{name}}” already exists in this paper's library. “Replace” puts the new profile in its place; the old file is kept, with its tags and notes, in the paper's backups (.replaced folder, not listed). Tags and notes are not carried over to the new profile. “Keep both” adds the new profile under another name and leaves the old one untouched. Every version built from this chart stays in its history.
mesures.print_chart_hint: This chart was never printed. Printing goes through the wizard's preview, checks and confirmation.

chart_create.title: Create a profiling chart

guided.title: One pass: one chart, one profile
guided.intro: targen spreads the patches over a single chart, preconditioned or not according to the starting point. The profile is built from its measurements.
guided.neutral_hint: Share of patches drawn towards the grey axis (targen -N, 0.50 by default in ArgyllCMS).
guided.needs_c: Needs a starting point (-c): without a profile, targen cannot tell where the neutral axis is.
guided.quality_hint: colprof -q. Offered at the profile step, where the line can still be changed.
guided.see_composition: The chart's paper is estimated in the composition, below.
guided.neutral_steps_hint: Steps computed from the starting profile. 0 by default.
guided.fwa_later: Optical brightener compensation (FWA): decided when the profile is built, from the actual measurements.
guided.profile_line_note: The colprof line is recorded with the chart and offered at the profile step, where it can still be changed.
guided.edit_line: Edit the targen line by hand
guided.created: Chart created from the guided settings.

chart_create.f_over: -f {{n}} exceeds the max ({{max}}) for this format
chart_create.tag_note: The chart will be tagged with the slot's RESIDENT profile, read live.
chart_create.print_confirm: Load {{paper}} ({{format}}), GE={{ge}}. The Z9 prints on receipt. Print?
chart_create.printed_next: Let it dry. Sheet: reload it dry via manual feed. Roll: rewind to the MAX at the panel (until the auto-stop, without disengaging). Scanning happens from the library.
chart_create.argyll_mode_print_desc: Compose then print a free chart on this paper. Scanning happens later, offline.
chart_create.argyll_mode_scan_desc: Pick a chart printed on this paper, scan it and build the profile.
chart_create.argyll_offline_note: Offline measurement: print → dry → reload the sheet → scan. No automatic mode.
chart_create.start_refine_desc: Pre-conditions the chart with the resident profile on this slot.
chart_create.start_built: Start from a profile built by freeglaz
chart_create.start_built_desc: A profile built here for this paper and this Gloss Enhancer, used only to spread the patches: it does not need to be installed.
chart_create.start_custom_desc: Use a custom profile as pre-conditioning.
chart_create.no_printed_charts: No printed chart for this paper.
chart_create.no_printed_charts_hint: Print a chart on {{paper}} first, then come back to scan it.
chart_create.scan_done_next: Measurement saved. Next step: build the ICC profile.
chart_create.validate_targen_hint: INDEPENDENT chart: quasi-random distribution (-q) ≠ the creation set, moderate count (verify, don't build). Non-overlap with the creation chart is verified a posteriori, in the validation report (after scanning).
chart_create.lighten_confirm: Removes the large chart raster (TIFF, ~99 % of the size) and KEEPS the measurements (ti3) + metadata. Chart {{id}} stays usable to re-profile / re-validate, but can no longer be reprinted.
chart_create.delete_confirm: Deletes EVERYTHING (raster + ti3 measurements + metadata) of {{id}} and frees all disk. The measurements will be LOST. Any ICC profile built from this chart is a separate file and is not affected.
chart_create.no_scanned_validation: No scanned validation chart for this paper.
chart_create.pick_scanned_chart: Resume an already-scanned validation chart (no reprint), or compose a new one:
chart_create.validate_ready_hint: The independent chart is measured. “Validate” compares the profile's PREDICTION to the measurements (true accuracy), without rewriting the profile.
chart_create.profile_done_next: Profile built. You can install it on the slot from the Papers page.
chart_create.preview_hint: Check the chart above before printing. Cancelling does not save it to the library.
chart_create.profile_done_local: Profile built (in the chart folder). Filing by paper unavailable (printer not identified at creation).

measure_qc.open_measures: See the measurements and the check
measure_qc.export_title: Exports all measurements (not only the filter), with the check columns when available.

summary.limited_one: No inconsistency detected by this check, with one limit: {{count}} measurement not assessable.
summary.limited_other: No inconsistency detected by this check, with limits: {{count}} measurements not assessable.
summary.limited_no_na: No inconsistency detected by this check, with limits (see below).
summary.clean: No inconsistency detected by this check.
summary.counts: {{n}} patches examined · {{strong}} strongly suspect · {{to_check}} to check · {{na}} not assessable
summary.disclaimer: Advisory check: each measurement is compared with the other colours of the same chart. It removes nothing, does not validate the measurements and does not guarantee the profile. A smooth drift of a whole region can escape it.

state.invalid: Check impossible: measurements not analysable ({{reason}}). This is not a "no anomaly" result.
state.unavailable: Quality check unavailable for this scan.
state.error: Technical error in the quality check. This is not a "no anomaly" result.
state.measurements_shown: The readable measurements are still shown below, without the consistency check.

status_title.strong: Large and reliable deviation from the other colours of the chart, or a failed physical check. Worth examining: it does not prove the measurement is wrong.
status_title.to_check: Moderate deviation from the other colours of the chart: worth a look, no conclusion.
status_title.not_assessable: The check cannot judge this measurement (insufficient or inconsistent neighbourhood). This is a limit of the check: neither a validation nor an error.
status_title.coherent: Consistent with the other colours of the chart according to this check (not a validation).

reason.PHYS_WHITE_SUSPECT: Paper white reading suspect: {{n_lighter}} patches lighter than it
reason.DUP_DISCORDANT: Discordant repeated readings: {{dist_to_median}} ΔE00 from the median of the {{n}} readings of this patch
reason.DUP_PAIR_DIVERGENT: The 2 readings of this patch differ by {{disagreement}} ΔE00
reason.DUP_TWIN_DIVERGES: Its duplicate deviates from the neighbours; this reading is consistent
reason.DUP_CONFIRMED: Confirmed by {{n}} agreeing readings of this patch
reason.MODEL_RESIDUAL: Inconsistent with the neighbouring patches: deviation {{residual}} ΔE00 (score {{score}})
reason.MODEL_EXTRAPOLATION: Unreliable prediction: extrapolation (edge or corner of the cube)
reason.MODEL_INCOHERENT_NEIGHBORHOOD: Unreliable prediction: neighbours inconsistent with each other or a very curved response
reason.HIGH_DEVIATION_UNRELIABLE_PREDICTION: Large deviation ({{residual}} ΔE00) but unreliable prediction: re-measure rather than conclude
reason.MONOTONIC_INVERSION: Lightness inversion: darker than patches carrying more ink ({{n_inversions}})

finding.SET_INCOHERENT: Globally inconsistent set: {{pct}} % of the patches have an inconsistent neighbourhood. Check the chart (offset, wrong file) before examining patches one by one.
finding.ZONE_INCOHERENT: Inconsistent zone: {{n}} patches around RGB ({{rgb}}). Re-measuring the zone is safer than judging each patch.
finding.SET_INCOHERENT_LOW_DENSITY: Neighbourhoods often inconsistent ({{pct}} % of the patches) on a sparse chart: this may come from the low density rather than from a mis-attributed chart. The check is not very conclusive on this chart.
finding.LOW_DENSITY: Sparse chart ({{n}} patches): the sensitivity of the check is reduced.

warning.LAB_COLUMNS_INCONSISTENT_WITH_XYZ: The file's Lab columns do not match its XYZ: the check uses the XYZ (what colprof reads).
warning.NO_XYZ_LAB_COLUMNS_USED: No XYZ in the file: the check uses the Lab columns.
warning.XYZ_SCALE_0_1_RESCALED: XYZ given on the 0–1 scale: rescaled to 0–100 for the check.
warning.NUMBER_OF_SETS_MISMATCH: The patch count declared in the file does not match the rows present.
warning.MERGED_FILE_ANALYSED: A file merging several sources was analysed: duplicates come from other scans.
warning.IDENTICAL_DUPLICATE_ROWS: Strictly identical measurement rows: not counted as independent readings.

table.swatch_title: Approximate on-screen preview (sRGB): measured | predicted. Not faithful outside the sRGB gamut; the numbers are the reference.
table.device_swatch_title: RGB value sent to the printer (not the measured colour)
table.de00_title: ΔE00 between the measurement and the prediction made from the other patches
table.reliability_title: Reliability of the prediction (not of the measurement)

filter.flagged_title: Strongly suspect, to check AND not assessable
filter.excluded_title: Readings excluded from the next profile by your decision

badge.title: Measurement consistency check of this scan (advisory). Click for details.

impact.duplicate: Another compatible reading of this colour remains ({{n}}): simple exclusion.
impact.interior: Last reading of this interior patch: it will be interpolated from its neighbours.
impact.face: Last reading of this face patch: it will be interpolated from its neighbours.
impact.edge: Last reading of this edge patch: the profile will be less constrained along this edge.
impact.corner: Last reading of a cube corner: the profile will be much less constrained in this region.
impact.refused_white: This is the last reading of white: excluding it would make the profile impossible to build.
impact.refused_black: This is the last reading of black: excluding it would distort the profile's black point.

level_explain.ok: No patch is left without a measurement.
level_explain.info: Information: the profile will estimate this colour from the neighbouring measurements.
level_explain.strong_warning: Strong warning: a new measurement is preferable if the patch is doubtful.

exclusion.base_not_used: scan not used in this mode
exclusion.bases_differ: The consequences differ depending on the build mode chosen.
exclusion.refused_advice: Measure the chart again, or add a scan containing a valid reading of this patch.
exclusion.reason_informative: The reason is kept for information; it does not influence the profile build.
exclusion.exclude_title: Exclude this reading from the next profile (reversible)
exclusion.reinclude_title: Re-include this reading in the next profile

use.excluded_title: Excluded from the next profile by your decision (reversible)

table.use_title: Included in or excluded from the next profile — independent of the QC check
table.risk_title: Consequence announced if this reading were excluded (confirmed at the time of the action)

risk_title.refused: Last white or black: exclusion refused

exclusion.scan_excluded_hint: This scan is excluded: readings can only be excluded in an included scan.

error.refused: Exclusion refused by the structural-point check.
error.scan_excluded: This scan is excluded: include it again to manage its readings.
error.not_found: Reading or scan not found: the data may have changed. The view was refreshed.
error.unreadable: Unreadable measurements: this exclusion cannot be evaluated.
error.network: The local server does not answer: nothing was saved.

build_preview.title: Build preview
build_preview.newly_applied_one: The current build uses the former rule ("last scan" base without exclusions): {{count}} recorded exclusion is not applied in it; this build will apply it. An effect of the rule, not a new finding of the check.
build_preview.newly_applied_other: The current build uses the former rule ("last scan" base without exclusions): {{count}} recorded exclusions are not applied in it; this build will apply them. An effect of the rule, not a new finding of the check.
build_preview.strong_included_one: {{count}} strongly suspect measurement stays included: you may review it before building.
build_preview.strong_included_other: {{count}} strongly suspect measurements stay included: you may review them before building.

guard.QC_ZONE_INCOHERENT: zone flagged inconsistent by the check
guard.QC_SET_INCOHERENT_ISOLATED_EXCLUSIONS: globally inconsistent set: isolated exclusions discouraged

build_preview.recommend: Measuring the chart again is recommended.

refusal.WHITE_LAST_READING: Build impossible: white has no reading left in the scans used. Re-include it, change the base or measure again.
refusal.BLACK_LAST_READING: Build impossible: black has no reading left in the scans used. Re-include it, change the base or measure again.

build_preview.differs_current: The inputs differ from those of the current profile: the build will produce a different profile.
build_preview.same_as_current: Same inputs as the current profile.
build_preview.confirm_title: Build the profile with these choices?
build_preview.confirm_note: The current profile and every previous version are kept. Exclusions remain reversible.
build_preview.inputs_changed: The measurements or the choices changed since the preview: the preview was recomputed, check it and confirm again.
build_preview.coverage_refused: The build was refused: a structural point has no measurement left. The preview was recomputed.
build_preview.selection_differs: Your current choices also differ from those of the current build.
build_preview.newly_applied_neutral_one: {{count}} recorded exclusion will be applied. The current profile has no reliable manifest: whether it took it into account cannot be known.
build_preview.newly_applied_neutral_other: {{count}} recorded exclusions will be applied. The current profile has no reliable manifest: whether it took them into account cannot be known.

profile_history.publication: Publication state: {{state}} (repaired at the next build).
profile_history.provenance_unknown: Earlier profile — unknown provenance (built before version tracking).
profile_history.provenance_partial: Earlier profile — partial provenance (original description kept).
profile_history.summary: Base: {{base}} · {{scans}} scan(s) · {{extra}} added chart(s) · {{profiles}} source profile(s) · {{excluded}} excluded reading(s) · {{holes}} patch(es) without measurement
profile_history.kept_note: Every version is kept; nothing is deleted automatically.

state.up_to_date_title: The same request, made now, would use exactly the same inputs.
state.stale_title: The measurements, exclusions or sources changed since the build: the profile is not defective, but a rebuild would give a different profile.
state.missing_input_title: A scan, chart or source profile used no longer exists.
state.unknown_title: Cannot be determined with certainty (profile without a reliable manifest).

toolchain.changed_title: The colprof version differs from the one used to build the profile.
toolchain.unknown_title: The colprof version is unknown on one side or the other.

profile_compare.title: Compare two versions of the profile
profile_compare.loading: Computing the differences between the two transforms…

error.argyll_missing: ArgyllCMS (xicclu) not found: the comparison cannot be computed.
error.altered_build: One of the versions is altered: comparison impossible.
error.network: The local server does not answer.

profile_compare.identical_files: The two ICC files are identical.
profile_compare.no_perceptual: Perceptual intent not compared: missing from one of the profiles.
profile_compare.swatch_note: Approximate preview of the RGB values sent
profile_compare.limits: Differences between two ICC transforms, computed offline (ArgyllCMS xicclu) on the measured patches ({{measured}}) and a {{grid}}³ control grid. This is not a new measurement: the comparison does not say which profile prints better. No profile is installed or rebuilt.
profile_compare.perceptual_same_both: In both profiles, the perceptual table (A2B0) is byte-identical to the colorimetric table (A2B1): the perceptual rows therefore repeat the relative ones.
profile_compare.perceptual_same_one: In profile {{side}}, the perceptual table (A2B0) is byte-identical to the colorimetric table (A2B1); the other profile has its own perceptual table.
profile_compare.focus_concentrated: Reading {{label}} (excluded in {{side}}): ΔE00 {{at}} at the patch, up to {{nearMax}} over {{nearN}} neighbouring points (within {{radius}}/255 in RGB); elsewhere at most {{farMax}} (p95 {{farP95}}). The difference is concentrated around this patch.
profile_compare.focus_descriptive: Reading {{label}} (excluded in {{side}}): ΔE00 {{at}} at the patch, up to {{nearMax}} over {{nearN}} neighbouring points (within {{radius}}/255 in RGB); elsewhere at most {{farMax}} (p95 {{farP95}}).

method.integrated_desc: Honeycomb chart, measured by the printer itself (Z9).
method.external_desc: Strip chart (ArgyllCMS printtarg), read with a USB spectrophotometer by chartread. Works with any printer model.

note.family_unknown: Printer not identified: the built-in scan only works on a Z9; the server checks it when scanning.
note.z9pro: Not available on the Z9 Pro: freeglaz cannot drive its built-in spectrophotometer.
note.options_unavailable: The list of external instruments could not be read.
note.no_instrument: The server offers no external instrument.
note.printtarg_missing: printtarg (ArgyllCMS) was not found: install ArgyllCMS to create an external chart.

measurement.preset: printtarg -i{{selector}}, strips laid out on a {{page}} mm working page.
measurement.to_verify_physically: Reading this chart with the instrument (strip length, reading direction) is still to be checked on a first real measurement.

media.only: External charts: the format follows the loaded paper, among those provided for this instrument ({{formats}}).
media.unknown: Loaded media unknown: it is checked when printing.
media.sheet_loaded: The loaded sheet is not a format provided for this instrument ({{formats}}): load one of them before printing this chart.
media.roll_width: The loaded roll is {{width}} mm wide; an external chart needs a {{expected}} mm (24") roll.
media.roll_source_unsupported: The paper is loaded on {{source}}: freeglaz prints on roll 1 only.
media.media_mismatch: This chart is laid out for the {{chart}} format; the loaded paper is {{loaded}}. Load the intended media, or create a chart for this format.
media.sheet_unidentified: The loaded media is not identified (source or dimensions not reported by the printer): a chart laid out for a sheet cannot be printed without them.

measurement.dims_after_creation: The number of strips, the size and the roll length are computed by printtarg when the chart is created, and shown before printing.
measurement.print_confirm: Print the {{instrument}} chart on “{{paper}}” (24" roll, GE {{ge}})? It uses about {{mm}} mm of roll.
measurement.print_confirm_sheet: Print the {{instrument}} chart on “{{paper}}” (one {{format}} sheet, GE {{ge}})? The chart is {{w}} × {{h}} mm, centred on the sheet.

preview.layout_transverse: Strips across the roll — strip A at the top, patch 1 on the {{side}}
preview.layout_transverse_sheet: Strips across the sheet — strip A at the top, patch 1 on the {{side}}
preview.layout_pages: printtarg pages stacked along the roll
preview.established: Strip geometry and order computed by printtarg; patch positions checked against the .ti2 on the chart pixels; printed by the usual freeglaz pipeline.
preview.to_verify_title: To check on the first reading
preview.to_verify: Reading with the instrument: strip length, ruler or hand reading, reading direction of the turned chart.
preview.color_not_proven: The real color rendering of this printer is not demonstrated for these charts.
preview.patches_value: {{l}} × {{w}} mm (long × wide, measured on the chart)
preview.option_high_density: high density, strips shifted by {{s}} mm
preview.not_read_yet: not yet read with the instrument

printed.title: Chart ready for an external measurement
printed.body: Let it dry, then measure it with the {{instrument}}. It waits in the library (Measurements tab).

included.incompatible: The included scans were not measured the same way (instrument or condition): they cannot be averaged. Exclude the ones you do not want, or build on the last scan.
included.insufficient: The identity of the included scans is not known well enough to average them.
included.record_invalid: A measurement record of this chart is unreadable.
included.unreadable: A scan of this chart is unreadable.

difference.calibration_standard_unknown: calibration standard reported on one side only

record_error.measurement_record_unsupported: The measurement record describes an unsupported instrument or setting.
record_error.measurement_record_mismatch: The measurement record does not match its measurements (modified file?).

remedy.exclude_scan: Exclude one of the measurements (role “Excluded”) to build from the others.
remedy.use_base_last: Or build on the last scan only.
remedy.remove_or_fix_the_record: The measurement record must be repaired or removed.

measurement.untracked_profiles_one: {{count}} source profile: the instrument of its measurements cannot be authenticated (measurements extracted from an ICC). It is combined as before, without identity check.
measurement.untracked_profiles_other: {{count}} source profiles: the instrument of their measurements cannot be authenticated (measurements extracted from an ICC). They are combined as before, without identity check.

source_compat_title.incompatible: Measured with another instrument or condition: the build would refuse to combine it.
source_compat_title.insufficient: Identity not known well enough: the build would refuse to combine it.
source_compat_title.record_invalid: A measurement record of this chart is unreadable.

validation.validation_identity_differs: Validation measured with another instrument or condition ({{validation}}; build: {{build}}): the result also contains the gap between them. This is not an error.
validation.validation_identity_unverified: The measurement identity of the build or of the validation scan is not known: they may differ.
validation.build_source_profiles_not_tracked: The profile also used measurements extracted from other profiles, whose instrument is not known.

generator_warning.patches_not_located_one: {{count}} patch could not be checked on the chart pixels (repeated or white colour): its place is the one printtarg gives.
generator_warning.patches_not_located_other: {{count}} patches could not be checked on the chart pixels (repeated or white colour): their place is the one printtarg gives.

layout_options.density_high_desc: Narrow strips, every other one shifted by half a patch (printtarg -h): about half the paper, a more demanding reading (ChromIQ presents it as a guided reading). Always at 100 % size.
layout_options.not_combined: High density is not combined with a reduced patch size.
layout_options.stagger: Every other strip shifted by {{s}} mm.
layout_options.not_validated: Geometry computed by printtarg, not yet read with the instrument.

estimate.title: Paper estimated before generating
estimate.value_roll: {{patches}} patches: {{strips}} strips of {{per}}, {{blocks}} block(s), {{w}} × {{h}} mm, about {{roll}} mm of roll.
estimate.value_sheet: {{patches}} patches: {{strips}} strips of {{per}}, {{w}} × {{h}} mm on the sheet.
estimate.needs_count: Give the number of patches (-f N) to estimate the paper before creating the chart.

external_measure.title: External measurement
external_measure.saved_counts: {{passes}} of {{total}} strips ({{patches}} of {{patches_total}} useful patches) remain saved.
external_measure.close_hint: Closing this window does not interrupt the measurement.

panel.title: External measurement ({{instrument}})
panel.has_scans_one: {{count}} measurement already recorded: quality control and profile building are in the Measurements tab.
panel.has_scans_other: {{count}} measurements already recorded: quality control and profile building are in the Measurements tab.
panel.has_scans_here_one: {{count}} measurement already recorded: its quality control and profile building are above.
panel.has_scans_here_other: {{count}} measurements already recorded: their quality control and profile building are above.
panel.published_next: quality control and profile building are in the Measurements tab.

prepare.condition_hint: To be chosen explicitly: it is part of the measurement identity, and two conditions are never mixed.
prepare.how: Strips are read one by one with the {{instrument}}'s button: freeglaz never starts a reading. Each strip is saved as soon as it is read; an interrupted session resumes where it stopped.
prepare.again: The previous measurement ({{stem}}) is published and stays with the chart. A new session starts from the first strip; once published, it is added to the chart's measurements.

presence.several: several instruments plugged in: leave only one
presence.error: the USB device list cannot be read here: this is not an absence, the start stays blocked
presence.present_family: an i1Pro 3 or 3 Plus is plugged in: the exact model is checked when it is opened, before any measurement

external_measure.presence_unchecked: freeglaz cannot list the USB devices: without this check the engine could open another instrument, so starting stays blocked.

start_blocked.absent: Plug in the {{instrument}}: the start button comes back as soon as it is detected.
start_blocked.other: The instrument plugged in is not the chart's {{instrument}}: the start button comes back as soon as the right one is detected.
start_blocked.several: Several instruments are plugged in: leave only the {{instrument}} and the start button will come back.
start_blocked.error: The instrument cannot be detected: the start button comes back as soon as the {{instrument}} is detected.
start_blocked.unreachable: freeglaz is not answering: the instrument cannot be checked for now. The start button comes back as soon as the {{instrument}} is detected again.

engine.development: Development engine: the session works, but its measurement cannot be published as a real acquisition.

calibrate.title: Calibration
calibrate.sensor_position: Turn the {{instrument}}'s dial to the calibration position (sensor facing the white tile), then confirm.
calibrate.white_reference: Place the {{instrument}} on its white reference tile, then confirm.
calibrate.white_calibration: Do a reflective white calibration, then confirm.
calibrate.explicit: Calibration only starts when you confirm.

wait.calibrated: Calibration done, getting ready to read…

read.reread: This strip was already read: reading it again replaces its values.
read.how: Place the instrument at the start of the strip, press its button and sweep the strip. freeglaz never starts a reading.
read.resume_body: The strips below are saved. Resuming starts at the first unread strip, without calibrating again while the calibration is still valid.
read.abandon_confirm: Abandon this session? Its files are kept, but it can no longer be resumed or published.
read.correct_hint: The strip is withdrawn from the save (a copy is kept); resuming asks for it first.
read.correct_confirm: Withdraw strip {{pass}} to read it again?

warning.wrong_strip: Not the right strip: read {{read}}, expected {{expected}}.
warning.comms_failed: Communication with the instrument lost during the reading.

warning_hint.wrong_strip: Put the instrument back on the expected strip and read it again. Keeping a wrong strip is never offered.
warning_hint.unexpected: Read the strip again. Keep it only if you are sure of the reading (a very saturated ink, for instance): this choice is noted in the measurement record.
warning_hint.default: Read the strip again, or stop the reading: the strips already saved stay acquired.

actions.accept_confirm: Keep this strip despite the unexpected value? The choice will be noted in the measurement record.

durability.reduced: Saved, reduced durability: this disk only allows a partial synchronisation (fsync only).
durability.reduced_lasting_one: Reduced durability seen {{count}} time on this disk during the session.
durability.reduced_lasting_other: Reduced durability seen {{count}} times on this disk during the session.
durability.not_durable: Save not confirmed: the file is written, but its synchronisation failed.
durability.refused: Save refused: the last strip read is not on disk.
durability.invalid: Save not kept: the session is suspended.
durability.recovered: Strips recovered after an interruption (validated file).
durability.correction: State after a strip was withdrawn.

event.corrected: Strip {{pass}} withdrawn to be read again

instrument_lost.title: Instrument lost
instrument_lost.body: The instrument no longer answers (unplugged, cable?). The measurement was stopped cleanly. Plug it back in, then resume.

output_flood.title: Error flood from the instrument
output_flood.body: chartread kept repeating the same error (usually a lost USB connection): the measurement was stopped.

engine_spinning.title: Engine stuck
engine_spinning.body: chartread was busy without producing anything: it was stopped.

engine_timeout.title: No answer from the engine
engine_timeout.body: chartread did not answer in time: it was stopped.

counts_diverge.title: Counts disagree
counts_diverge.body: chartread and freeglaz disagree about the strips read: the measurement was paused. Resume it to compare again.

engine_not_checkpointing.title: The engine does not save
engine_not_checkpointing.body: chartread does not confirm saving after each strip (-K): the measurement was stopped before any reading.

instrument_not_spectral.title: Instrument without spectra
instrument_not_spectral.body: This instrument gives no spectra: its measurement cannot be used for profiling.

instrument_type_mismatch.title: Not the session's instrument
instrument_type_mismatch.body: The instrument that was opened reports “{{found}}”; this session expects “{{expected}}”. Nothing was measured or saved: plug in the right instrument and start again.

instrument_type_unknown.title: Instrument not identified
instrument_type_unknown.body: The instrument that was opened did not report its type: the session stopped before any measurement.

instrument_serial_unknown.title: No serial number
instrument_serial_unknown.body: The instrument that was opened did not report its serial number: the session stopped before any measurement.

instrument_unit_changed.title: Another instrument plugged in
instrument_unit_changed.body: This is not the instrument the session started with (different serial number). Plug the first one back in, or abandon the session.

start_failed.title: Could not start
start_failed.body: chartread could not open the instrument (absent, busy or not supported).

driver_failure.title: Driver failure
driver_failure.body: The freeglaz driver hit an error and stopped chartread.

checkpoint_refused.title: Save refused
checkpoint_refused.body: chartread could not save the last strip (disk full?). It is not saved and will be read again on resume. Free some space, then resume.

checkpoint_not_durable.title: Save not confirmed
checkpoint_not_durable.body: The last strip is written, but its durability is not confirmed (the folder could not be synchronised): the session is suspended. Check the disk, then resume.

checkpoint_invalid.title: Invalid save
checkpoint_invalid.body: The file chartread wrote does not match the chart (instrument, condition, strips): it was not kept and the session is suspended.

session_write_failed.title: Could not write
session_write_failed.body: freeglaz could not save the session state (disk full?). The session is suspended; it will be put back in order on resume.

interrupted.title: Session interrupted
interrupted.body: freeglaz stopped during the reading. The saved strips are intact: resume whenever you like.

exited.title: chartread stopped
exited.body: The engine stopped by itself. The saved strips are intact.

publish.published: It is recorded as {{stem}} ({{n}} readings) and appears in the Measurements tab.
publish.accepted_one: {{count}} unexpected value was kept during the reading.
publish.accepted_other: {{count}} unexpected values were kept during the reading.

notice.stale: The measurement state had changed: it was reloaded, nothing was sent.
notice.sse_lost: Event connection interrupted: refreshing every 2 seconds.

selector.title: Strategy
selector.one_desc: One chart, then the profile. Guided settings as for two passes, or a free targen line and a .ti1 file.
selector.two_desc: A first chart to learn the paper, then a finer second chart spread from what the first one learned. freeglaz composes the ArgyllCMS lines and keeps the link between the two passes, even after closing.

step.done: final profile built (other profiles can still be built without printing again)

compose.pass1_intro: An evenly spread chart, without preconditioning. Its measurements give an intermediate profile used only to prepare pass 2.
compose.pass2_intro: The patches are spread from the intermediate profile of pass 1: denser where the paper needs them. The final profile is built from this chart.
compose.pass2_patches_hint: Planned now to estimate the paper; can be changed when pass 2 is created.
compose.neutral_hint: Share of pass 2 patches drawn towards the grey axis (targen -N, 0.50 by default in ArgyllCMS).
compose.precondition_note: It only spreads the patches. The printed values stay raw: the chart is tagged with the resident profile, like every chart.
compose.over_capacity: {{n}} patches exceed this format's capacity ({{max}}): lower the count or choose another format.
compose.pass2_over_capacity: Pass 2 ({{n}} patches) will not fit this format ({{max}} max): you can choose another format, a roll for instance, when you create it.
compose.grey_steps_hint: 0 by default: OFPS already covers the grey axis.
compose.neutral_steps_hint: Steps computed from the intermediate profile. 0 by default.
compose.smoothing_hint: Assumed average deviation of the readings, in %. 2.0 by default (smoother); 1.2 was the July session's setting.
compose.source_gamut_hint: Only shapes the perceptual and saturation tables stored in the profile (other software). freeglaz's conversion does not depend on it.
compose.viewing_hint: Source then destination of the gamut mapping. Without a source gamut they have no effect.
compose.fwa_later: Optical brightener compensation (FWA): decided when the final profile is built, from the actual measurements.
compose.instrument_locked: Instrument and measurement conditions inherited from pass 1.

lines.gamut_alias: -S {{alias}} = {{file}}, a free profile bundled with freeglaz (Elle Stone).
lines.not_validated: Reasoned starting settings, not a demonstrated colorimetric optimum.

paper.total: Estimated total for both passes: about {{m}} m of roll.
paper.see_composition: The paper of each pass is estimated in the composition, below.

created.precondition: Preconditioned by the intermediate profile of {{id}}; its copy is kept with the chart.

notice.resident_changed_since_first_pass: The resident profile of this paper changed since pass 1 (another profile installed on the slot?). The values are still sent raw.

fallback.explain: OFPS did not complete. Quasi-random spreading (-Q) is a possible fallback, faster but less optimised.

error.precondition_build_required: The intermediate profile of pass 1 is not given.
error.precondition_build_unknown: This version of the intermediate profile does not exist.
error.precondition_build_altered: The intermediate profile changed on disk: build it again.
error.precondition_not_intermediate: This profile is not an intermediate profile.
error.precondition_not_current: The intermediate profile was built again since: resume from pass 1.
error.precondition_stale: The measurements of pass 1 changed since the intermediate profile: use "Prepare pass 2" to build it again.
error.strategy_conditions_changed: The paper and the Gloss Enhancer of the profiling are fixed by pass 1.
error.strategy_instrument_locked: The measurement instrument is inherited from pass 1.
error.strategy_measurement_unknown: The included measurements of pass 1 do not tell one instrument and one condition: nothing to inherit.
error.earlier_pass_frozen: The settings of pass 1 can no longer be changed.
error.strategy_run_mismatch: This chart is not pass 1 of a two-pass profiling.
error.strategy_run_required: Pass 2 must be attached to its pass 1.
error.targen_failed: targen could not generate the chart.
error.param_out_of_range: A value is out of the accepted range.
error.unknown_param: A setting does not belong to this pass.

print.blocked: Print refused, no paper used: the conditions differ from pass 1 ({{list}}).

code.first_pass_print_unknown: the print conditions of pass 1 are not known

intermediate.title: Intermediate profile
intermediate.purpose: It is only used to prepare pass 2. It is never installed, never filed with the profiles, never offered for printing.

state.stale: Stale: the included acquisitions changed since it was built ({{date}}).

intermediate.acquisitions: The {{n}} included acquisitions of this chart are averaged.
intermediate.prepare_hint: First builds the intermediate profile (preview above), then opens the pass 2 composition.

final.title: Final profile
final.made_from: Chart spread with the intermediate profile of {{id}} (version of {{date}}).
final.variant_pass2_hint: By default: the measurements of pass 2 alone.
final.variant_pass1_pass2_hint: Joins the measurements of both passes, for comparison. It is not presumed better; both profiles stay comparable in the version history.
final.variant_unavailable: The passes 1 + 2 variant needs the pass 1 chart and its measurements.
final.gamut: Source gamut: {{alias}}, i.e. the bundled file {{file}}. It only shapes the stored perceptual and saturation tables.
final.fwa_refused: The line asks for -f, but these measurements do not allow it: the build will be refused.

fwa.identity_unknown: Disabled: the instrument or the measurement condition is not known.
fwa.no_spectra: Disabled: these measurements hold no spectra.
fwa.instrument_without_uv: Disabled: the ColorMunki lamp emits no ultraviolet; ArgyllCMS cannot compensate brighteners from its readings.
fwa.instrument_not_supported: Disabled: ArgyllCMS has no lamp model for this instrument.
fwa.condition_unknown: Disabled: the measurement condition is not known, it is not presumed to be M0.
fwa.condition_not_m0: Disabled: measured under another condition than M0.

chart_print.title: Chart to print
chart_print.printed_at_one: Already printed on {{date}}: this will be a new print.
chart_print.printed_at_other: Already printed {{count}} times, last on {{date}}: this will be a new print.
chart_print.scans_kept_one: Its measurement stays: those of the new print are added to it, and you can exclude the old one in Measurements.
chart_print.scans_kept_other: Its {{count}} measurements stay: those of the new print are added to them, and you can exclude the old ones in Measurements.

not_printable.lightened: Lightened chart: its image was deleted, it can no longer be printed.
not_printable.tiff_missing: This chart's image cannot be found: it cannot be printed.
not_printable.not_resident_tagged: Chart in an older format, without the paper's resident profile: create a new chart to print.
